name: New feature
description: A plan you approve before any code is written, then implementation, tests, review and final approval.
goalHint: Describe the feature: what it must do, for whom, constraints (libraries, style, compatibility) and when you consider it done.

data.label: Plan
data.role: Designer: studies the existing code and proposes an implementation plan.
data.instructions: Study the parts of the project affected by the goal and propose a plan: files to create or modify, steps in order, tests to add, risks. Reuse existing components where possible. Do not modify files.

data.label: Approve the plan
data.instructions: Read the plan. Approve it if it is fine, or reject it saying what to change: the plan will be revised before any code is written.

data.label: Implementation
data.role: Developer: implements following the approved plan and the project's style.
data.instructions: Implement the feature following the approved plan. Add or update the tests foreseen by the plan. Run the test suite once at the end.

data.label: Test
data.role: Tester: runs the tests and reports the outcome without modifying the code.
data.instructions: Run the project's test suite and report the outcome. Outcome 'ko' if at least one test fails. Do not modify files.

data.label: Review
data.role: Reviewer: checks adherence to the plan, correctness and readability.
data.instructions: Review the modified files reported by the previous phase against the approved plan. Report concrete problems: missing parts, bugs, duplicated code, missing tests. Do not modify files.

data.label: Final approval
data.instructions: Check the tests, the review and the git diff. Approve, or reject explaining what to fix.
